claim_definition: Verifies that the Only OS gateway session produces a signed GatewayClaim JWT carrying EAT profile tag `tag:agentrust.io,2026:trace-v0.1` that passes all four mandatory TRACE Level 1 test modules (TR-ENV, TR-SIG, TR-RTE, TR-POL) when executed against the agentrust-io/trace-tests conformance suite. The claim binds five attestation anchors: `eat_profile` (EAT profile URI), `trace.runtime.platform` (TEE or software-mode platform identity), `trace.policy.bundle_hash` (SHA-256 of the enforced policy bundle), `trace.cnf.jwk` (confirmation key bound to the session), and `gateway.audit_chain` (root-to-tip hash chain covering the session audit log). A session whose GatewayClaim JWT fails any mandatory module is treated as an unverifiable evidence unit and triggers GER-339.
scope: Only OS gateway session TRACE claim output; trace-tests conformance suite Level 1
excluded_scope: TR-TXN (Phase 2 tool-call transcript binding), TR-ANC (SCITT transparency anchoring), TR-SCA (SLSA provenance) — scheduled for DGV v0.6.0

test_cases.description: Validates the EAT envelope structure of the GatewayClaim JWT. The runner asserts that all six required top-level claims are present, that `eat_profile` equals `tag:agentrust.io,2026:trace-v0.1`, and that `iat` is a valid NumericDate no more than 300 seconds in the past at verification time.

Validates the Ed25519 (EdDSA) signature over the GatewayClaim JWT and confirms key binding. The runner verifies the JWS compact serialization using the public key embedded in `trace.cnf.jwk`, asserts the `alg` header is `EdDSA`, and checks that the confirmation key thumbprint matches the session identity. ES256 and ES384 are accepted as alternative algorithms if `alg` is declared accordingly, but EdDSA is the Only OS default.

Validates the TEE platform field and measurement format inside `trace.runtime`. The runner asserts that `trace.runtime.platform` is a non-empty string and that `trace.runtime.measurement` is a 64-character lowercase hex string (SHA-256). In hardware TEE mode the measurement reflects the enclave MRENCLAVE or equivalent. In software-only mode (`CMCP_DEV_MODE=1`) the platform value is the literal string `"software"` and the measurement is a deterministic SHA-256 of the gateway startup configuration (sorted JSON canonical form), satisfying the `hex64` format requirement without requiring a hardware RIM URI.

Validates the policy bundle hash binding and enforcement mode declared in `trace.policy`. The runner asserts that `trace.policy.bundle_hash` is present and matches the pattern `sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}`, and that `trace.policy.enforcement_mode` is the string `"enforcing"`. A value of `"permissive"` or `"audit"` causes this module to fail, signalling that the gateway is not operating under binding policy controls.
